name: Story Teller
original_name: ストーリー テラー
source:
The Storyteller is the creator and ruler of Labyrinthia. He has the ability to make whatever story he writes come to pass in the real world.

[From [url=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Storyteller]Ace Attorney Wiki[/url]]
